problem: Map the CLI command surface area for comparison with proposed Email and WhatsApp interfaces. CLI is the reference interface that new channels should mirror.

files.why: CLI entry point and command router. 12 top-level commands: login, token, inspect, comments, preview, library, org, tickets, skill, update, --version, --help.
Ticket subcommand router: list, latest, get, create, rerun, continue, artifacts, artifact, bundle, update-description.
Comment subcommands: list (with --ticket, --helix-only, --since filters), post (with --ticket flag).
Inspect subcommands: repos, db (--repo + SQL), logs (--repo + query), api (--repo + path). Key ns-gm/inspect interface.
Library subcommands: list, show, comments (list/post). Section-rated content interface.
Org subcommands: current, list, switch. Multi-org context management.
HTTP client with retry logic, auth headers (API key or Bearer token), 30s timeout. Server communication layer.
Config management: ~/.hlx/config.json, multi-org entries, env var overrides (HELIX_API_KEY, HELIX_URL).
Ticket reference resolution: exact ID, short ID (RSH-596), numeric suffix. Flexible input parsing pattern for natural language interfaces.
Flag/argument parsing utilities. Structured command parsing that email/WhatsApp would need to replicate via NLP or structured templates.
Skill install/show for agent integration. CLI-only capability, likely not applicable to email/WhatsApp.
Preview db-url command: prints Neon preview branch connection URI. Developer-only, security-sensitive.

facts: CLI exposes 12 top-level commands with subcommands totaling ~30 distinct operations.
Core ticket operations: list, latest, get, create, rerun, continue, artifacts, artifact, bundle, update-description.
Comment operations: list (with helix-only/since/ticket filters), post (with optional --ticket context).
Inspect operations: repos (list), db (SQL query), logs (query), api (GET path). All read-only.
Library operations: list items, show item with section annotations, list/post section comments.
Auth: multi-org with API keys (hxi_*) or Bearer tokens. Stored in ~/.hlx/config.json.
Communication: pure request-response HTTP via hxFetch() with 3-attempt retry and exponential backoff.
Output: human-readable tables (default) or structured JSON (--json flag). No interactive/streaming mode.
No notification/push capability in CLI - users must poll (hlx tickets list, hlx comments list --since).
Build: tsc. Test: tsc && node --test. No lint command.
Package: @projectxinnovation/helix-cli v1.3.4, published to npm, binary name 'hlx'.
